results.title: Postpone panchayat, municipal elections to April-May next year: Ladakh group
results.content: “We suspect that this government is up to some mischief. We saw ‘vote chori’ in West Bengal, Bihar, Haryana, Maharashtra etc. In entire India 13 crore voters were dropped from the voter list. Ladakh is a small region and fraud is easy,” said Ladakh Buddhist Association (LBA) chairman Tsering Dorjey Lakrook

results.title: At peak of air pollution on Deepavali, data goes missing at several government monitoring stations in Delhi
results.content: Missing PM2.5 data for several hours on CPCB website understated city’s pollution levels: experts; 227 PM2.5 observations were missing across 59 stations; govt. will look into it: Mishra

results.title: Atiqa Mir produces overtaking masterclass to finish 6th on FIA World Championship debut
results.content: In a recovery rarely seen in this Championship, Atiqa put on an overtaking masterclass by making up 16 places in Race 1 and finishing P6, which happened to be also the highest by an Indian this weekend

results.title: Anuj lights up Indian chess, becomes the 100th GM
results.content: The 22-year-old from Madhya Pradesh, who quit his software engineering job to pursue a career in the sport, says that it feels good to join the roll of honour and all the hard work has paid off
